# Wicklight Labs: Lamp Bible, Lamp Lock and HoloVault

> Wicklight Labs makes small, private iPhone apps. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. All are free to download with optional subscriptions.

## Lamp Bible: Daily Verse

Free iPhone Bible app with a daily verse widget for the Lock Screen and Home Screen, the KJV and World English Bible offline, audio Bible, reading plans, a prayer list, Sleep with Scripture, and Ask, AI answers that quote real verses checked word for word. Also in Spanish with the Reina-Valera 1909.

- [Website](https://wicklightlabs.com/lampbible/): features, price, privacy and FAQ
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lamp-bible-daily-verse/id6818715500)
- Price: Lamp Bible is free to download, with the daily verse, widgets, the full Bible, audio and the prayer list free. Lamp Premium adds unlimited Ask, Sleep with Scripture, a reflection with every verse, every reading plan and all themes: $39.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $4.99 a week (US prices).
- Privacy: No account, no ads and no tracking. Your prayers, notes, highlights and plans stay on your iPhone. Ask sends only the question you type, and only after you agree to it.

Common questions:

- Is there an app that puts a Bible verse on my iPhone Lock Screen? Yes. Lamp Bible has Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets that show a new Bible verse every day. Add the widget once and the verse changes on its own each morning, with no internet needed.
- Does Lamp Bible have the King James Version? Yes. Lamp Bible includes the King James Version (KJV) and the World English Bible, both stored on your phone so they work offline. The Spanish edition uses the Reina-Valera 1909.
- Is Lamp Bible free? Yes. The daily verse, widgets, the full Bible, audio and the prayer list are free. Lamp Premium ($39.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $4.99 a week in the US) adds unlimited Ask, Sleep with Scripture, every reading plan and all themes.
- Can an AI Bible app give wrong verses? In Lamp Bible's Ask, every verse an answer cites is checked against the Bible text and replaced with the exact words before you see it, so the scripture you read is always the real text.
- Does Lamp Bible work without internet? Yes. The Bible, the daily verse, the widgets, plans and the prayer list all work offline. Only Ask needs a connection.
- Is there a Bible in a Year plan? Yes. Lamp Bible has The Bible in a Year (365 days), the New Testament, and shorter plans such as John in 21 Days and Proverbs in 31 Days.

## Lamp Lock: Bible App Blocker

Christian app blocker for iPhone built on Apple's Screen Time: chosen apps stay locked until you read a Bible verse, pray or read a chapter, then open for a set time. Strict mode, focus sessions, daily limits, schedules, reading plans, guided prayers, streaks and Circles with friends. No account, no ads.

- [Website](https://wicklightlabs.com/lamplock/): features, price, privacy and FAQ
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lamp-lock-bible-app-blocker/id6818823592)
- Price: Lamp Lock is free to start: lock one app with today's verse. Lamp Lock Premium locks as many apps and categories as you like and adds strict mode, daily limits, schedules, focus sessions of any length and every plan: $39.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, $5.99 a week, or $79.99 once for life (US prices).
- Privacy: Lamp Lock uses Apple's Screen Time, so it never sees which apps you use or for how long. No account, no ads, no analytics. Everything stays on your phone unless you choose to use Ask or Circles.

Common questions:

- Is there an app that makes me read the Bible before opening Instagram or TikTok? Yes. Lamp Lock locks the apps you choose with Apple's Screen Time. When you open one, you read today's verse (or pray, or read a chapter) first, and then the app opens for 15 minutes.
- What is the best Christian app blocker for iPhone? Lamp Lock is a Christian app blocker that puts a Bible verse between you and your most distracting apps. It adds strict mode, focus sessions, daily limits and reading plans, with no account and no ads, and the first app is free to lock.
- Can I lock apps until I pray? Yes. Instead of reading the verse you can pray a short guided prayer, written for mornings, anxious thoughts, focus or rest, to unlock your apps.
- Does Lamp Lock see what I do on my phone? No. Lamp Lock works through Apple's Screen Time, which keeps app names and usage on the device. Lamp Lock never sees which apps you use and has no analytics.
- Is Lamp Lock free? Lamp Lock is free to start and locks one app with today's verse. Premium ($39.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, $5.99 a week, or $79.99 once, US prices) locks any number of apps and adds strict mode, limits and schedules.
- Can I do it with friends or my small group? Yes. Circles lets you share your streak with friends, family or a small group using a code. Only a nickname and your streak are shared, and only if you join.

## TCG Card Scanner: HoloVault

iPhone TCG card scanner for Pokémon, One Piece, Disney Lorcana and Yu-Gi-Oh! cards: scan one card, a stack or 200 photos, see today's market price and a year of price history, track collection value like a portfolio, open packs with Pack Rip, set checklists, wishlist price alerts and a Christmas list to share. No account, no ads.

- [Website](https://wicklightlabs.com/holovault/): features, price, privacy and FAQ
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tcg-card-scanner-holovault/id6819069009)
- Price: HoloVault is free to try with 25 scans and 25 cards. HoloVault Pro gives unlimited scans and cards, Performance, full price history, price alerts and every theme: $39.99 a year for every game with a 7-day free trial, $19.99 a year for one game, or $5.99 a week (US prices).
- Privacy: No account, no ads, no tracking. To identify a card, only the cropped photo of that card is sent, read by a third-party AI service and not stored on our server. Prices come from licensed market data, never from AI.

Common questions:

- What app can scan Pokémon cards and tell me what they're worth? HoloVault scans Pokémon cards (and One Piece, Disney Lorcana and Yu-Gi-Oh! cards) with your iPhone camera, finds the exact card, set and number, and shows today's market price with a year of price history.
- Is there a Lorcana or One Piece card scanner for iPhone? Yes. HoloVault scans Disney Lorcana and One Piece Card Game cards as well as Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh!, and tracks the value of your whole collection across all four games.
- How do I track my card collection's value? Scan or search each card in HoloVault and add it to your collection. HoloVault shows the total value, how it moved since the last prices, a value chart, and what you paid against what it's worth.
- Can I scan a whole pack while opening it? Yes. Pack Rip mode scans every card as you open a pack, keeps a running total, and shows what you pulled against what the pack cost, ready to share.
- Is HoloVault free? HoloVault is free to try with 25 scans and 25 cards. HoloVault Pro ($39.99 a year for every game with a 7-day free trial, $19.99 a year for one game, or $5.99 a week in the US) removes the limits.
- Where do HoloVault's prices come from? From licensed market price data, updated daily, shown with its source and date. AI only reads the name and number printed on the card; it never sets a price.
